title: sergeant_deleted_my_course
display_title: My Drill Sergeant Made Me Delete My Parkour Map — So I Deleted Something Else
beats: My drill sergeant found out I built a Minecraft parkour course with two thousand subscribers, and gave me a direct order to delete it.
I said yes sergeant, and deleted it that night, camera rolling for my channel.
What I didn't delete was the shared server backup I quietly restored to a private world an hour earlier.
What he didn't know was that his teenage son was one of my subscribers, and had begged me on stream to keep it up.
Three weeks later the course was back online under a new name, and his own kid sent him the link, bragging his dad was 'basically famous' in the comments.
